notes: Bookmarks are useless (83 per-file bookmarks all pointing at page 1). The book has a text layer and a 'New Bob Book Index' on pdf pp2-7 (title ..... page, 3 columns, 666 entries, many titles truncated). I parsed the index text and mapped printed page -> pdfPage = page+7 (printed 1 = pdf 8), then read the full title and, where on the same line, composer from each page's own text layer. All 666 pages checked automatically (page title matched the index title); 19 differed only in wording (e.g. 'Getting Sentimental' vs "I'm Getting Sentimental Over You") and were set by hand from the page text; 4 pages (Driftin' 136, Lady Bird 321, Lament 322, Love Letters 343) have no title in the text layer (only the page number) so conf=med. Composer filled for ~227 entries only (when on the title line). Pages with no entry are 2nd pages of tunes.
